subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Sujit Patel <sujit@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@cloudbridge.io>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks + proposed next step (technical deep dive / demo)

Hi Marissa & Camila,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning - really helpful to understand Redwood's runtime and where CloudBridge's managed integrations could add value for our joint customers.

As discussed, we'd love to set up a partner-led technical deep dive / demo next. Proposed objectives:
- Quick architecture walk-through of Redwood Dedicated options
- Integration points for CloudBridge marketplace connector
- Initial SSO/KMS and network requirements checklist

I've attached a draft agenda and a short spec on connector expectations. Our engineering lead Laura and I are available next week. Here are a few slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-12 10:00-11:00
- Wed 2026-10-13 13:00-14:00
- Thu 2026-10-14 09:00-10:00

Please let us know what works and who from your side should join (technical PM / infra / sales). If you prefer, feel free to share a Calendly link and we'll pick a time.

Thanks,

Sujit Patel
Partnerships, CloudBridge
S: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: partner-demo-agenda.pdf, cloudbridge-connector-specs.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sujit Patel <sujit@cloudbridge.io>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks + proposed next step (technical deep dive / demo)

Hi Sujit - great to connect earlier. Appreciate the clear agenda.

We can do Tue 2026-10-12 10:00-11:00 PT. I'll block that on our side. Attendees from Redwood: me (partnerships), Camila (partner engineering lead), Ben (solutions engineer). Can you confirm Laura will be the technical lead from CloudBridge and whether you want the session recorded?

Next steps:
1) I'll send a calendar invite for 10/12 10:00 PT and include the agenda you attached.
2) Camila will follow up on required technical materials and invite an engineer from our infra team.
3) If there are any specific compliance questions ahead of time (SOC2, data residency), flag them and we'll pull the security team in.

Thanks - looking forward to the deep dive.

- Marissa
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sujit Patel <sujit@cloudbridge.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks + proposed next step (technical deep dive / demo)

Thanks Marissa / Sujit - adding our infra lead Dev to the thread.

Dev, can you join 10/12 10:00 PT and prep a short slide on our Dedicated deployment network & KMS patterns (5-7 mins)? Also please pull the connector integration checklist (or point me to the doc) so we can align on pre-reqs ahead of the meeting.

Sujit - Laura, if you have any environment-specific notes (VPC peering, firewall ranges, or preferred auth flows), please drop them here so we can get the right folks involved.

Camila Reyes
Partner Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Sujit Patel <sujit@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@cloudbridge.io>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks + proposed next step (technical deep dive / demo)

Perfect - Tue 10/12 10:00 PT works for us and Laura will lead the technical portion. Recording is fine.

Laura: are you able to share any short docs on the connector endpoints or auth expectations before the call? If not, we can walk through the spec attached in the agenda.

We'll expect an invite & calendar link. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Sujit
Partnerships, CloudBridge
